messages:
maria_marketing: Quick ask for the launch deck + blog: can runtime produce a tight comparison (latency, cost/unit, and warmup delta) between redwood/llama-13B@v1.3.0 (float) and the new quantized candidate q4_1? Need short/med/long context buckets and a tiny artifact bundle we can attach to the blog.

tonY_runtime: We can do it. Need to confirm: exact context cutoffs, whether to include function-call style prompts, and do you want raw traces for tail analysis? Also which pricing basis?

maria_marketing: Cutoffs: short <=64, medium 256-512, long 1024-1536. Yes include a small function-call slice (our demo uses it). Please collect traces for 95th tail. Pricing: normalized cost units per 1k tokens; well map to hosted dollars in a follow-up. Deadline: artifacts uploaded by Mon 11am PT so design can finalize slides.

lee_eng: Proposed bench method: sample 1.5k requests per bucket from the marketing prompt pack, stratified by token length, warmup 8 requests per replica, measure a steady 5k request window. Capture p50/p90/p95 latencies, throughput (tokens/sec), and memory usage spikes. For cold-start, record two variants: (1) real cold start including model load and GPU attach, (2) preloaded weights with empty KV cache. We'll mark both in notes.

pat_prod: Add note to capture average tokenization overhead for function-calls vs plain prompts; tokenization differences have bitten us before.

tony_runtime: Sounds good. I'll run paired jobs for float and q4_1. Command (example):

```
benchctl run --model redwood/llama-13B@v1.3.0 --variant float --buckets short,medium,long --samples 1500 --warmup 8 --steady 5000 --collect pcts=50,90,95 --artifacts=png,csv,trace --tag "launch-quant-compare"
```

And same for --variant q4_1. Expect ~2.5h per job. I'll prioritize steady-state CSVs and PNGs for slides first, then raw traces.

maria_marketing: Good. Also please include a one-paragraph methodology blurb we can paste into the blog (what we measured and caveats).

lee_eng: Will do. On retention: runtime keeps full raw logs for 14 days by default. Marketing ok with that?

maria_marketing: 14 days is fine.

benchbot: Job scheduled: job_id=job_2026040107, queued_by=tony_runtime, est_time=2.5h, artifacts=png,csv,trace. Link: https://bench.internal/jobs/job_2026040107

tony_runtime: Kicking off now. Will post the steady-state csv/pngs first (ETA ~2.5h) and trace tarball after. If anything looks off (high variance or OOMs) I'll flag and we can rerun with larger sample.

maria_marketing: Perfect  thanks! If variance is high please capture a quick note with the run explaining possible causes so we can avoid misleading statements on the slide. :pray:
